title: Telepathic projection from a Canadian facility to make Michigan residents mail their tax forms
place_text: south central Canada; Upper Peninsula of Michigan; West Virginia

tellings.quote: and 85% of the people did it next year.

plain: Dan Sheehan says that in the 1970s a facility in south central Canada tried to beam thoughts by telepathy to people in Michigan's Upper Peninsula to get them to mail in their tax forms, and that "85% of the people did it next year." Sheehan, a guest on an episode about UFOs and President Kennedy, credits the story to reports by Ingo Swann and names Pat Price, two men tied to that kind of mind work, and he also places part of it in West Virginia. If true, it would mean governments had tested steering whole populations by thought.
